_comment: Set and family membership by worn-item-name fragment (DpsCalculator.wearsAll/wearsAny/setWeight; a fragment matches any version of the item, so New/Used/Broken moon pieces all count). 'all' lists every piece a set effect needs, in the order the check short-circuits; 'any' lists the alternatives one role accepts; 'weights' is each piece's weight in a scaling set - crystal (accuracy x(20+n)/20, damage x(40+n)/40 with a crystal bow or bow of faerdhinen; Inactive pieces never count) and inquisitor (crush accuracy and damage x(200+n)/200, mace-agnostic).
